versions.description_html:
Discover SharePoint Embedded in M365. Learn what it is, how file containers and security work, billing, and how apps use it without a standard user interface.

There's a whole part of Microsoft 365 that has no screen at all. It's called SharePoint Embedded, and it stores files for apps instead of for people.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What It Actually Is
  • The Container Idea
  • Where Your Files Live
  • The Security Story
  • What You Get Built In
  • It's Not a SharePoint Site
  • How the Billing Works
  • Where You'll Meet It
  • The Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Stop Reinventing SPFx- Building Better SharePoint Solutions with PnP React Controls with Siddharth Vaghasia [MVP]
  • Building Modern Microsoft 365 Solutions with SharePoint Framework, Microsoft Graph, PnPjs & Great User Experiences with Julie Turner [MVP]
  • More Developer Practices episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Developer Practices: the most-listened episodes
